research.title: CVE-2026-68820 is in KEV. Here Is What CISA BOD 26-04 Actually Requires Now

research.title: Tokenomics of quality: switch sonar list issues to --format toon for measured token savings

research.title: Claude Code hooks and how Sonar Vortex verifies AI code inside the loop
research.summary: An agent deleted someone's home folder . Again. This story is becoming all too familiar: A coding agent runs rm -rf , a tilde expands to the wrong path, and twenty years of files are gone. The agent apologizes in flawless prose. The files do not come back..

research.title: Claude Opus 5: An evaluation review & metrics benchmarks
